title: RunLine Hub
features:
Main Tab
• Auto Kill Mobs – Automatically attacks and kills mobs.
• Auto Collect Loot – Automatically collects loot like boss drops.
• Auto Boss Raid – Automatically does boss raids for selected boss.
Upgrades Tab
• Auto Buy Skill Points – Automatically converts mana into skill points.
• Auto Upgrade Skills – Automatically upgrades selected skill/s.
• Auto Ascend – Automatically ascends once you are eligible.
Machines Tab
• Auto Fuse – Automatically fuses selected weapons.
• Auto Sacrifice – Automatically sacrifices selected weapons.
Teleports Tab
• Teleport To Zone – Teleports you to the safe zone of selected zones.
Miscellaneous Tab
• Auto Equip Best – Automatically equips the best weapons.
• Hide Notifications – Hides all annoying notifications.
Player Tab
• Walkspeed Changer – Self explanatory
• JumpPower Changer – Self explanatory
Settings Tab
• Anti-AFK – Prevents being kicked due to inactivity.
• Toggle UI – Toggles the UI.
